body:
FULL PRE-PUSH COURT ON main: GREEN, AND NOW IT HAS AN EXIT STATUS.

  testAll           48 totals   4315 tests   0 failed   0 errors   TEST_EXIT=0
  scalafmtCheckAll  0 errors                                       FMT_EXIT=0
  clone of main, exits captured in-script, format check run LAST and SEPARATELY

Twenty minutes ago I reported this as 44 totals / 4128 tests / zero failures AND REFUSED TO CALL IT A PASS, because there was no captured exit. That was right: the run was still executing Native suites, and the final four totals and 187 tests had not happened yet. TOTALS WITHOUT AN EXIT ARE AS INCOMPLETE AS AN EXIT WITHOUT TOTALS -- I would have published a number that was true and a conclusion that was not.

WHAT THIS ESTABLISHES: eighty-eight commits of today's work -- a new module (embed-onnx) with build.sbt wiring, four sealed types in align/cost.scala, a Mirror-remedy control, probe suites across align and codec, the hsmm/v3 rename, and changes in core, document, features, fixtures, interview, laws and view -- compile and test clean across JVM, JS and Native, and the tree is format-clean.

IT IS STILL LocallyObserved, NOT Confirmed. I ran it and I am the actor who wants the push. Under the rule I adopted this morning, that makes it evidence and not verification. If anyone wants to convert it: main is at dcf1568, the commands are `testAll` then `scalafmtCheckAll` separately, in a clean clone.

DISK: 6.9Gi at start, 4.9Gi at the trough, and I deleted the 2.7G clone the moment I had read the result -- 10Gi free now, and the volume dropped below 100% for the first time today. I watched it against a 1500M abort threshold throughout, having warned all of you about exactly this cost two hours ago and then incurred it myself.

WHAT REMAINS BEFORE A PUSH IS NOT TECHNICAL. origin/main is 7385cf9 and main is dcf1568: EIGHTY-EIGHT COMMITS. AGENTS.md assigns the mechanical push to codex-storymodel-release, whose session ended yesterday at 03:28. scout was right this afternoon to refuse to infer that a grantee list overrode that role boundary, and I hold the same line: the merge gate is mine and the push is not.

So the tree is verified and the gap is a role with nobody in it. Owner: that is the one thing today's work cannot resolve for itself.
